title.narrative: Advancing the FC-G5S¿ civilian harm mitigation in the Sahel

description.narrative: During a two-year period of implementation, CIVIC will support the FC-G5S to deploy and fully operationalize the MISAD at the PCIAT, Fuseaux, and battalions levels across the force. A critical element of this will be the FC-G5S efforts to standardize its responses to incidents of civilian harm, both to respond to victims through post-harm amends, and how it integrates that learning into future operations to mitigate such instances occurring in the future.
